title: klayout-tools knowledge base entry
description: One published circuit design (topology, sizing strategy, layout idioms) that the LLM reasoning module can draw on. See kb/README.md for the sourcing rules that every entry must satisfy.

id.description: Stable slug; must match the entry's filename stem (kb/entries/<id>.json).

spec_class.description: What kind of spec this design serves (e.g. 'low-power PHY bias/reference').

pdk_portability.description: What changes / what's PDK-specific vs. portable about this design. Optional: omit or set null when not yet characterized.

primary_pdk.description: The PDK this entry was evaluated/designed against, e.g. 'sky130'.

notes.description: What is PDK-specific vs. portable to other PDKs.

sizing_approach.description: How device sizes/bias points were derived. Optional: omit or set null when not applicable.

layout_idioms.description: Layout techniques used, e.g. common-centroid matching, guard rings. Optional: omit, null, or empty when none apply yet.

source.description: Citation for the design. Must satisfy the open-sources-only rule in kb/README.md.

citation.description: Full citation: authors, title, venue/year, or repo URL + license.

url.description: Link to the source, if available. Optional: omit or set null when none exists.

license_or_openness.description: Why this source clears the open-sources-only bar. Optional: omit or set null only when self-evident from the citation.

notes.description: Free-form notes. Optional: omit or set null when there is nothing to add.
